config.label: Cookie Chain RPC endpoint
config.description: Cookie Chain RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public Cookiescan RPC (https://rpc.cookiescan.io).

config.label: Wallet key for money-moving tools (base58 secret, solana-keygen JSON array, or a path to a keypair file)
config.description: Wallet key for money-moving tools (base58 secret, solana-keygen JSON array, or a path to a keypair file). Optional — without it the server runs read-only and money-moving tools return a clear error. The key is used only to sign locally and is redacted from all output.

config.label: Hard per-transaction spend cap in COOK; money-moving tools refuse inputs valued above it (0 disables)
config.description: Hard per-transaction spend cap in COOK; money-moving tools refuse inputs valued above it (0 disables). Defaults to 100.

config.label: Default slippage tolerance in basis points (500 = 5%)
config.description: Default slippage tolerance in basis points (500 = 5%). Defaults to 500.

config.label: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint, used only by the bridge tool
config.description: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint, used only by the bridge tool. Defaults to the public endpoint, which is rate-limited; a dedicated RPC is recommended for reliable bridging.
